items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And Marcus Haynes from the Globetrotters, he was one of the matre d's, too.

ctx.x: Was it known who it was that opened it, who the owners were?

I never knew who the owners were, but they said it belonged to Joe Lewis, but it didn't. They were using his name to attract, you know, customers. And Marcus Haynes from the Globetrotters, he was one of the matre d's, too. He had left the Globetrotters, stopped playing basketball. And after that he went back to Oklahoma, to his home in Sand Springs.
And Benny Carter had the band there, right?
